planets.name: HD 1397 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 1397 with a 11.5-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: HD 1397 b was found in 2018 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 1397. Its orbit and size follow Nielsen et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
